name: slack_renewal_request
use_case: Pick up an access request from Slack and reply in the thread after approval
branch: Bob Jones posted in #it-ops asking to renew deployer access that is expiring; IT desk reads the thread and creates a renewal access request for APP-PROD deployer
tests: reads Bob Jones's Slack thread in #it-ops and creates a new pending access request for his deployer role renewal
instruction:
You are Maya Lin, an IT operations lead. Bob Jones (E412) posted in #it-ops (message timestamp 1792933200.000412) stating his deployer access on APP-PROD is expiring and asking for renewal. You want the IT assistant to read his Slack thread, check access policy for the role, and submit a new pending access request for Bob Jones for the deployer role.

Your details:
Target employee: Bob Jones (E412)
Target application: APP-PROD
Target role: deployer
Slack channel: #it-ops (CH_ITOPS)
Slack message timestamp: 1792933200.000412

persona.name: Maya Lin
persona.initial_message: Bob Jones posted in #it-ops asking for renewal of his expiring deployer role. Could you check policy and create the renewal request for him?

arguments.justification: Renewal of deployer access expiring on the 31st
